verifications.claim: The U.S. stock market (NYSE and Nasdaq) is closed on Good Friday, April 3, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'the New York Stock Exchange and the Nasdaq — will be closed on Friday, April 3'; R2/R9: 'Good Friday: Friday, April 3' in stock holidays list; R3/R5: 'U.S. stock markets, including the Nasdaq and the New York Stock Exchange, will be closed Friday, April 3'; R4: 'the U.S. Stock Market, including the Nasdaq and New York Stock Exchange, will be closed'; R6: 'The stock markets on New York Stock Exchange and the Nasdaq are closed for trading on Good Friday, April 3, 2026'; R7: 'The two major U.S. stock exchanges - the New York Stock Exchange and the Nasdaq - will be closed on Friday, April 3'; R10: 'the two major U.S. stock exchanges are taking the day off'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state NYSE and Nasdaq are closed on April 3, 2026, for Good Friday.

verifications.claim: Bond markets close early at noon on Good Friday, April 3, 2026.
